en:
You're cute, though.
My patrons will be pleased.
I have an announcement for you ladies.

As is customary, I grant a gift to you tonight!
The blood of men, beaten from their bodies.
It is time, for the Banquet of Blood.
Let us begin.
As for your chef tonight...

The owner of Stardust,
yours truly, Joon-gi Han!
Don't worry about me, Aniki.

Ultimately, he's only askin' for
a one-on-one fistfight.

Y'shouldn't underestimate
the Hiroshima yakuza.
You've yet to tell me your name.

I'm from the Yomei Alliance's
Hirose Family, Yuta Usami.
I must thank you, Usami-san.

You shall serve as my bait
to draw out the Dragon of Dojima.

If you think this is gonna be easy,
you've got another thing comin'.
Duly noted. I look forward to it.
Now, let us begin!
Take this!

Well met, Yuta-kun. That should help you
save face before your beloved "Kiryu-aniki."

Are you trying to disgrace us!?
Let Yuta-kun go. And drop the knife, too.

What are all of you looking at?
Show some respect to our victor.

Kazuma Kiryu has defeated me.
Applause for the Dragon of Dojima!
Sensational! Moreover, a grand display!

I see now why the old guard of the
Jingweon are so troubled by your existence.
And what about this sportsmanship of yours?
A man accepts defeat with grace.

Becoming the embodiment of that grace
is my fight now, and in that, I am victorious.
I humbly offer my respect.

You needn't worry.
I'll keep my promise.
Does it hurt, Yuta-kun?

You're the one who got yer ass kicked by
Kiryu-aniki. I could ask you the same.
You have such hate in your eyes...

I approached our fight fair and square.
Surely you could sense my intention.

Either way, it's in the past now.
Shall we shake on it?
You're pretty damn nuts.
Here's a picture of Tatsukawa.

Are we talking about the same Tatsukawa?
I need you to be sure.

Indeed. He resigned from his post
soon after I assumed ownership of Stardust.
And where is he now?

Before I tell you that, I'd like to
know why you're looking for him.

How is such an insignificant man
connected to someone like you?
That's none of your business.
Perhaps you're right.

However, consider how much we
already know of your recent activity.

Isn't it a shame to beat around the bush
like this instead of speaking plainly?

For example, we're aware of the accident
Haruka Sawamura was in a few days ago.

As you might expect, we're also aware of
her relationship to you, Kiryu-san.

This little investigation of yours must be
related to that accident somehow.

Is it possible that Tatsukawa-kun had
something to do with Haruka-san's incident?
I'm not going to say more than I have to.

Or are you saying your ties to Tatsukawa
go deeper than a boss to an employee?

I wouldn't say I have ties at all,
but he's an interesting man nonetheless.

It seems becoming a host wasn't really
the reason he came to Kamurocho.

I believe Tatsukawa's job here at Stardust
was merely to divert attention from him.
A diversion?

Soon after Tatsukawa quit his job here, he was
seen spending a lot of time in Little Asia.
Were you aware that he can speak Chinese?
He's tellin' the truth, Kiryu-aniki.

Tatsukawa knows Chinese. At least
enough t'teach me and Tagashira.
Huh. So you speak it as well.

I expect you picked it up in hopes of
wooing some cute Chinese girl?
Wh-What if I did?

Affairs of the heart are one of the best
motivators for learning a new language.

After Tatsukawa-kun left, he used his Chinese
to get work as an informant in Little Asia...
Specifically, for the Saio Triad.

All signs point to that being the real reason
for his coming to Kamurocho to begin with.

So even when Tatsukawa was in Onomichi,
he was communicating with the triads?

Then, in order to hide his ties to them,
he ended up as a host in Kamurocho?

Yuta. You've known Tatsukawa
since you were young, right?
Is he capable of something like that?
I guess so, but it's hard to imagine...

Kiryu-san. I'd like to know why you're
looking for Tatsukawa. Won't you tell me?
My curiosity is positively piqued.
I'm not obligated to tell you that.

The only promise we made was that you'd
tell us about Tatsukawa after the fight.

A fair point.
That is indeed what we promised.
I know where Tatsukawa-kun currently lives.
In Kamurocho, naturally.

Down an alley off Senryo Avenue
is a place called the Ouka Building.

He's been seen taking Chinese women
up to the second floor on various occasions.
Okay. That's all I needed to know.
It was a great honor to meet you, Kiryu-san.

There are rumors... The Jingweon are fanning
this war between the Tojo Clan and the Saio.

I suppose if both sides wiped each other
out, we'd gain a foothold in Kamurocho.

However, I assure you that rumor is baseless.
No truth to it whatsoever.
I see. We'll be going now.

Feel free to come back any time.
You're always welcome, Kiryu-san.

Kiryu-aniki. Do you want to
head over to Tatsukawa's place?
Huh? Is something wrong?

Tatsukawa lives in an alley
off Senryo Avenue.

Haruka's accident took place
right around Senryo Avenue as well.

There can't be much distance
between the two places.
I doubt that's a coincidence.

But until we get our hands on Tatsukawa,
we won't know anything for certain.

Still, if he <font_kind=yakuza_italic>was</font_kind> involved in the accident,
I can't promise I'll hold anything back.

Even if he's Haruto's dad.
And even if he's an old friend of yours.
I know. I feel the exact same way.
Aniki. I'll go find Captain Nagumo.

Do you want to meet up over
in front of the Ouka Building?
Don't go in until we get there.

The more people we have, the harder
it'll be for Tatsukawa t'get away.
See ya later.
Kiryu-aniki. This way.
Yer the real deal, Aniki.

Y'been in Kamurocho fer jus' one day n'
y'already figured out where Tatsukawa is.

Y'know Kamurocho like the back o' yer hand.
Jus' me n' this fool woulda been hopeless.

I'm glad you're okay, Nagumo.
You did well fighting off the Jingweon.

Um, Cap... You said you were fightin'
the Koreans that whole time, didn't you?

I'm confused, though. It kinda smells like
you were in a bubble bath or somethin'.
What? Oh, uh...

T'be honest, the Jingweon Mafia guys
stopped comin' right after y'left.

So, I reckoned I'd head over t'Stardust
myself, but I got lost on the way there.
And then?

Then... uh, well I was walkin'
'round Kamurocho at night, so...

Y'can't be serious, Cap. Did you really get
one of Kamurocho's... special massages?

W-Well... I guess if y'put it like that...
Yeah.
For cryin' out loud...

H-Hear me out, though! It was a great
chance t'take in the city life firsthand!

I gotta say, Aniki, the ladies in Tokyo're
jus' so damn sexy. And real naughty, too!

I'll take ya t'the place later.
No need fer glarin' at me like that!

I see. I guess Joon-gi Han was right about
the depravity of our society. Right, Aniki?
Huh? What're ya goin' on about?

Let's just focus on Tatsukawa.
That's the Ouka Building there.

Tatsukawa...
I hope that bastard's in there.
He should be on the second floor.

C'mon, Aniki! This is the punkass who
knocked up our sweet Haruka-san.

Let's drop a whuppin' on him first,
then we can talk after.

So the victims were one man and one woman.
You didn't know either of them, right Kiryu?

Right. I only ever saw a photo of Tatsukawa,
and I definitely don't recognize the woman.
I see. I guess that's that, then.

But weren't you saying that this Tatsukawa
fellow is the father of that baby?

In other words, he's a sleazy ex-host who
knocked up a girl you treat as a daughter.

It wouldn't be such a far-fetched story
for you to kill a man for that.

Easy, Honjo.
He's not our suspect here.

Until we can prove otherwise,
everyone involved is a suspect.

After Tatsukawa left his job as a host,
he spent a lot of time in Little Asia.

Apparently he was working as
an informant for the triads.
Were the police aware of that?
No, he wasn't even on our radar.

But I think it's pretty clear-cut who
killed Tatsukawa... The Saio Triad.

The murder weapon and modus operandi
line up with some other Saio incidents.

By the way, the female victim who was with
Tatsukawa was a Kamurocho-based hostess.

Dating him unfortunately landed her
in the wrong place at the wrong time.

Date-san. You shouldn't be divulging
so many details about an open case.

Kiryu went all the way to Hiroshima
to find the father of that child.

Then for the father to turn up dead here,
he probably knows more than we do.

It's also thanks to Kiryu that we ID'd
Tatsukawa so quickly.

I figure, it's only fair to be upfront
about the intel we've got.

From where I'm standing, it looks
more like collusion. How about that?
He's been out of the yakuza for years, man.
It's okay, Date-san.

By the way, can you drop by Serena later?
I still have some questions for you.

That sounds good. I'll come alone.
You go on over and wait for me, Kiryu.
Right. See you.

(Nagumo and Yuta are waiting at Serena.
I should head there myself...)

How'd it go?
Y'get anythin' from the cops?
A few details, yeah.

By the way, a detective friend of mine named
Date is going to be stopping by here later.
He's married to the mama here.

Sorry about this, Mama.
We're always using your place for meetings.

I don't mind, you can use it however you want.
You go back further with this place than I do.

So that Mama...
She's hitched to a detective?

Good thing I didn't go puttin' my moves
on 'er. Ain't that right, Yuta?
Are you all right, Yuta?

'Parently this is the first time he's
seen someone he knows dead.
It's got 'im really down in the dumps.

He wasn't askin' you. Besides Cap, you've
been just as quiet as me until right now.

Listen, y'ass. I was jus' stayin'
quiet t'give ya yer space.

According to the police, the triads
were the ones who killed Tatsukawa.
You're talkin' about the Saio Triad, right?

Yeah. If you remember, Tatsukawa was
working as an informant for them.

It's possible he made a mistake
and paid the price for it.

Those guys did some
real messed up shit, man.

First they slit his throat, then stabbed 'im.
Were they tryin' t'make an example?

Somehow, it's like that dead guy
back there wasn't the Tatsukawa I knew.

I thought he came
t'Kamurocho to be a host.

But then it turns out he was
a triad informant.

And just when we pin him down,
he winds up dead as a rat.

Y'know, I came to Tokyo so I could beat
Tatsukawa to death for what he did...
...But now I don't know what to think.
So what's the plan, Aniki?

Tatsukawa's literally a dead end,
and anything about Haruka-san died with 'im.

I know that. But I need to figure out
why he was killed by the Chinese.
Why's that?

If Tatsukawa had the triads coming after him,
Haruka and Haruto might be involved, too.

If that's true, does that mean Haruka's
accident wasn't an accident at all?
I don't know enough to say for sure.

Either way, we have a lot to learn
about Tatsukawa's life here.
Kiryu. Mind if I join you?

So you're Hiroshima's Hirose Family?
And you're involved with the Yomei Alliance?

Yeah we're Yomei, but we report t'the
Masuzoe Family. We're the bottom rung.

But back in the day, our patriarch Toru Hirose
used t'really whoop on the Omi Alliance.
A cop like you'd know his name, right?

Y'serious? Guess Tokyo detectives ain't
the hotshots they pretend t'be.
Anyway, Kiryu.

I have something I need to tell
you about Haruka's situation.

While you were down in Hiroshima,
I moved her out of her room at Touto.
She's at the police hospital now.
Something happen?

Yeah, we started getting frequent calls
from people who claimed to be Tojo men.

They insisted they wanted to see Haruka,
and wouldn't stop calling us about her.
The Tojo Clan wanted Haruka?

Well, there's no way to verify if they
were really Tojo Clan guys or not.

Better safe than sorry, though.
That's why I had her transferred over.

And just in case, I have her room under
supervision so nobody gets too close.
Has her condition improved at all?
Unfortunately, no.

If I can offer my opinion here, I'd say
you should avoid her until things calm down.

If someone tailed you and learned where she
was, I'd be all out of places to keep her.
I just wish she'd wake up already...

What's Akiyama up to?
He was watching Haruka, right?

I asked him to keep his distance after
we transferred her to the police hospital.
Remember, the triads are gunning for him.

It would be a disaster if they found
him hanging around our hospital.
